$comment: Checks in jdk-differential.test.ts that fail today, each tied to the roadmap issue (#3) that should fix it.
Listed checks run as it.fails(): the suite stays green, and turns red when a fix makes one pass. Delete the entry then.
"issues": what the failure is waiting on, main issue first. "reason": the symptom, in a few words.
See the details of any case with: npx tsx scripts/java-diff.ts <case id>

collections/coll-arrays-aslist-fixed.reason: Arrays.asList(...).add() succeeds instead of throwing UnsupportedOperationException

collections/coll-arrays-tostring-objects.reason: Arrays.toString ignores the elements' toString() (prints P@1)

collections/coll-char-keys.reason: HashMap<Character, Integer> prints in insertion order, not Java's hash order

collections/coll-concurrent-mod.reason: removing from a list inside its for-each throws no ConcurrentModificationException

collections/coll-fqn-scanner.reason: new java.util.Scanner(...) creates an object of class 'java'

collections/coll-hashmap-order-strings.reason: HashMap iterates in insertion order, not Java's hash order

collections/coll-hashset-order-ints.reason: HashSet iterates in insertion order, not Java's hash order

collections/coll-list-equals.reason: List.equals compares identity instead of elements

collections/coll-list-of-immutable.reason: List.of(...).add() succeeds instead of throwing UnsupportedOperationException

collections/coll-list-of-user-objects-pr.reason: an explicit list.toString() ignores the elements' toString()

collections/coll-list-remove-object-vs-i.reason: list.remove(Integer.valueOf(40)) removes by index instead of by value

collections/coll-list-set-index.reason: list.set() past the end grows the list instead of throwing IndexOutOfBoundsException

collections/coll-map-computeIfAbsent.reason: Map.computeIfAbsent with a lambda is unsupported (Unknown method)

collections/coll-map-merge.reason: Map.merge with the method reference Integer::sum is unsupported

collections/coll-priorityqueue-comparato.reason: PriorityQueue ignores its lambda comparator (natural order, no error)

collections/coll-priorityqueue-print-ord.reason: PriorityQueue prints fully sorted instead of in Java's heap-array order

collections/coll-queue-remove-noarg.reason: queue.remove() with no argument crashes with a JavaScript TypeError

collections/coll-scanner-input-mismatch.reason: Scanner.nextInt() on "abc" returns 0 instead of throwing InputMismatchException

collections/coll-sort-comparator-lambda.reason: List.sort ignores its lambda comparator; Collections.reverseOrder() is unsupported

collections/coll-word-count.reason: HashMap prints in insertion order, not Java's hash order

compile-errors/ce-lossy-conversion.reason: runs int n = <double>, which javac rejects (possible lossy conversion)

compile-errors/ce-missing-return.reason: runs a method with a missing return statement

compile-errors/ce-string-minus.reason: runs "5" - 1, which javac rejects (bad operand types)

compile-errors/ce-type-mismatch.reason: runs int x = "hello", which javac rejects (incompatible types)

compile-errors/ce-undeclared-var-late.reason: runs until it reaches an undeclared variable javac reports before running

compile-errors/ce-uninitialized-local.reason: runs count++ on a local that was never assigned

compile-errors/ce-wrong-arg-count.reason: runs add(1) against add(int, int) instead of rejecting the call

core/array-3d.reason: new int[2][3][4] builds only two dimensions

core/array-print-direct.reason: println(char[]) prints [h, i] instead of the characters

core/boxed-methods.reason: methods on boxed values (Integer.compareTo, Double.intValue) are unsupported

core/deep-recursion.reason: recursion 900 deep overflows the JavaScript stack

core/field-init-shadow-caller-local.reason: a field initializer reads the caller's local x instead of the field

core/field-init-uses-field.reason: a field initializer can't see earlier fields (Variable 'size' is not defined)

core/integer-cache.reason: Integer == ignores the -128..127 cache; Integer.equals is unsupported

core/labeled-break.reason: labeled loops and break label are skipped

core/labeled-continue.reason: labeled loops and continue label are skipped

core/main-args.reason: main's args isn't bound (Variable 'args' is not defined)

core/math-misc.reason: Math.rint(2.5) rounds half up instead of half to even

core/num-double-div-zero.reason: floating-point division by zero throws ArithmeticException instead of Infinity/NaN

core/num-double-printing.reason: doubles print without Java's scientific notation (1.0E7)

core/num-float.reason: float arithmetic and printing use double precision

core/num-int-from-char.reason: int x = 'a' keeps the char instead of converting to 97

core/num-long-literal.reason: long literals and arithmetic wrap at 32 bits

core/num-ternary-promotion.reason: a conditional with int and double branches doesn't promote to double

core/object-default-methods.reason: Object.equals is missing when a class doesn't override it

core/overload-by-type.reason: overloads are chosen by argument count, not type

core/overload-ctor-by-type.reason: constructor overloads are chosen by argument count, not type

core/parseInt-invalid.reason: Integer.parseInt("12abc") returns 12 instead of throwing NumberFormatException

core/sb-methods.reason: StringBuilder.setCharAt / delete / replace / indexOf are unsupported

core/stack-overflow.reason: infinite recursion overflows the JavaScript stack instead of throwing a catchable StackOverflowError

core/static-field-name-collision.reason: qualified static reads return null, and A.count / B.count share one static namespace

core/string-charAt-oob.reason: charAt past the end returns \u0000 instead of throwing StringIndexOutOfBoundsException

core/string-compareTo.reason: String.compareTo returns -1/0/1 instead of the character or length difference

core/string-equality-ref.reason: new String("hi") isn't a real string, so equals fails

core/string-format-rounding.reason: String.format rounds with JavaScript's toFixed and prints e+1 for %e

core/string-new-from-chars.reason: new String(char[]) and String.valueOf(char[]) don't build strings

core/string-split-regex.reason: split() isn't regex-based and keeps trailing empty strings

core/switch-default-first.reason: default written before the matching case is taken

core/var-keyword.reason: new java.util.ArrayList<>() creates an object of class 'java'

extra/boxed-identity-eq.reason: Integer == compares values, ignoring the -128..127 cache

extra/lit-hex-octal-binary.reason: hex, octal and binary literals are parsed as decimal

extra/println-int-array.reason: "" + intArray gives [1, 2, 3] instead of an identity string like [I@1b6d3586

extra/string-builder-identity.reason: strings have no identity, so == on distinct equal strings is true

misc/exc-printStackTrace-stream.reason: printStackTrace() writes to stdout instead of stderr

misc/exc-system-err.reason: System.err output is mixed into stdout

misc/misc-integer-division-in-method-unc.reason: a double method's int return value isn't converted to double

misc/misc-math-long.reason: long values wrap at 32 bits; Long.MAX_VALUE loses precision

misc/misc-string-methods-more.reason: String.chars() (and the stream after it) is unsupported

oop/oop-abstract-class.reason: inherited methods are not found (Unknown method: s.report())

oop/oop-anonymous-comparator.reason: an anonymous Comparator is ignored (natural order, no error)

oop/oop-custom-iterable.reason: for-each over a user Iterable (anonymous Iterator) is unsupported

oop/oop-enum-basic.reason: enums are unsupported (Variable 'Color' is not defined)

oop/oop-exception-toString-and-uncaught.reason: exception toString() lacks the java.lang. package prefix

oop/oop-inheritance-basic.reason: inherited methods are not found (Unknown method: a.describe())

oop/oop-inherited-field-access.reason: inherited fields are not found (Variable 'sides' is not defined)

oop/oop-interface-constant.reason: interface constants are not found (Variable 'LIMIT' is not defined)

oop/oop-interface-default-method.reason: interface default methods are not found

oop/oop-object-toString-default-call.reason: Object.toString is missing when a class doesn't override it

realistic/real-flood-fill.reason: new String(char[]) doesn't build a string

realistic/real-shape-hierarchy.reason: an abstract superclass toString() calling area() prints Circle@1

refs.reason: list.set() past the end leaves holes in the list's backing array

js-errors.reason: queue.remove() shows "Cannot read properties of undefined"

scopes.reason: after continue, the next for-each header step still shows the previous iteration's 'doubled'
